style: Gritty comic-book style illustration for a dark-fantasy deckbuilder. Heavy, slightly rough black ink outlines with ink hatching in the shadows; cel shading with two or three tones per colour; a subtle grunge paper texture; saturated but slightly muted colours. No text, no letters, no numbers, no frame, no border, no watermark, no UI.
style_refs_note: The attached images are style references from the same card set. Match their drawing style exactly: line weight, ink hatching, cel shading, paper texture and level of detail. Follow the subject, layout and background described below, not the references.
card_layout: One clear subject shown close-up, usually entering from the lower-left edge and moving diagonally toward the upper right, partly cropped by the frame. Background: a flat colour field crossed by sharp, jagged, diagonal brush-streak shapes in a darker tone. White curved motion arcs around anything that moves; a burst of debris, sparks or glowing particles at the point of impact. Readable at thumbnail size.
